channel.title: Calendly incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Calendly's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Users Unable to Log In to Calendly due to blank Login Page [resolved]
item.description: We have resolved the issue that prevented users from logging into Calendly.

item.title: Degraded performance on Calendly.com [resolved]
item.description: We are continuing to monitor the system to ensure everything remains stable.

item.title: Error on Meetings page [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved, and we are closely monitoring the situation to ensure continued stability.

item.title: GoToMeeting Integration [resolved]
item.description: GoToMeeting APIs experienced issues that caused GoToMeeting events to not be created. The issue has now been resolved by GoToMeeting.

item.title: Calendly.com experiencing issues [resolved]
item.description: The team has resolved issues that were preventing users from loading calendly.com

item.title: Issues for IE11 Users [resolved]
item.description: This morning our engineers identified an issue that may have caused users using IE11 to experience problems with the login and booking flows. All issues have been resolved and we are continuing to monitor to ensure stability.

item.title: Outlook Desktop Plugin [resolved]
item.description: Outlook Desktop functionality has been restored for all users.

item.title: Deleting an event in your calendar may not cancel Calendly events [resolved]
item.description: Google has resolved their API issues and all Calendly functionality is now restored.

item.title: Zoom Video Conferencing Degraded Service [resolved]
item.description: Zoom has returned to full functionality and links should resume automatically generating. If you require any additional assistance please reach out to support@calendly.com.

item.title: Google Login Issues [resolved]
item.description: All login services have returned to stable at this time.

item.title: Degraded Connectivity with Zoom Video Conferencing [resolved]
item.description: Zoom has deployed a patch that resolves an issue with OAuth authorizations that affected a small segment of users. We believe that this issue has been resolved. If you continue to experience any issues, please reach out to support@calendly.com.

item.title: Calendly.com experiencing issues [resolved]
item.description: Service has been fully restored.

item.title: iCloud Integration Issues [resolved]
item.description: Apple has resolved the issue. iCloud users should no longer be impacted.

item.title: Server Error [resolved]
item.description: Fix has been confirmed. Thank you for your patience!

item.title: Issue Enabling Third Party Integrations [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved for all users

item.title: Outlook 365 Login Issues [resolved]
item.description: DNS issues affecting logins using the Outlook 365 service appear to have been resolved. If you experience any further issues, please reach out to support@calendly.com

item.title: Calendar events are not being saved when users select GTM or Zoom as their location [resolved]
item.description: Issue has been resolved. All calendar events and correspondence should be fully operational.

item.title: Calendly Site Not Loading [resolved]
item.description: Calendly site is back up and fully functioning.

item.title: Calendly site not loading [resolved]
item.description: Issue has been resolved and we are continuing to monitor.

item.title: Google Cloud Service Disruption [resolved]
item.description: Google reports that its services have been fully restored and the issues are now resolved.

item.title: Calendly Outage [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved and we are continuing to monitor performance.

item.title: Stripe billing unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Stripe has resolved the issue and their billing functionality has been restored within the Calendly system. https://status.stripe.com/

item.title: Calendly down [resolved]
item.description: Cloudflare systems have recovered and access to Calendly and Zendesk has been restored. Our developers will continue to monitor going forward.

item.title: Unable to connect to Google Calendar service [resolved]
item.description:
Google reports that its services have been fully restored and the issues are now resolved.
More information on the status of the Google Calendar service can be found at https://www.google.com/appsstatus#hl=en&v=issue&sid=2&iid=cc21ebe3962430b2e4ae2b52e3dde98f

item.title: Stripe unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
Stripe billing and account upgrade/downgrade functionality have been fully restored.
On 2019-07-10, the Stripe API was unavailable from 16:36–17:02 UTC, and again from 21:14–22:47 UTC. Stripe has confirmed that systems are restored and fully operational.
